previous_batch.place_summary: Parc de Bruxelles is also known as Parc Royal, an established public park near the Royal Palace. A 2016 guide and 2026 editorial page name it as an outdoor meeting/cruising location, but neither constitutes a dated firsthand 2026 visit. Access subject to regional park rules.

Park authority says obey displayed hours and special closure rules

Cached page top comments 2025-08-11–16; August 13 firsthand-style claim says half park closed, others ask about accessible sections, not 2026 proof. Source driving direction mapped 50.8448410034,4.3640785217. 641 comments counter is page-specific cached snapshot, not 2026 visitor count.

previous_batch.name: Citadelpark
previous_batch.place_summary: Citadelpark, Ghent: independently documented over decades, including an older official municipal gay history walking-guide citing areas by grotto, open-air theatre and waterfall. A 2026 GayOut page describes continued outdoor cruising, but its September update does not establish a recent firsthand visit; a 2024 resident comment is pre-cutoff. Municipal 2026 renewal initiatives may affect conditions.

p3_2026_11_08.original_report: Current Gays-Cruising country index names Citadelpark as claimed cruising site, no archived candidate-specific direct page URL. Primary index content examined.

alternatives.finding: Independent 2026-accessible editorial explicitly describes specific sections: promenade from museum parking to music kiosk, ornamental grotto and slope behind it. Site-specific written guide, not first-person date-stamped activity.
OFFICIAL city 2026 updates: waterfall reactivated, renewed kiosk in use through end-2026, ring paths under works with new lighting, Casinokop facade restoration. No overall park closure.
OFFICIAL 2 July 2026: kiosk/amphitheatre and Casinokop/rose garden are two separate community renewal test areas; specific subareas identifiable and not interchangeable.

previous_batch.name: Carpool Holsbeek
previous_batch.place_summary: Carpool Holsbeek is a defined road-side park-and-ride at the Holsbeeksesteenweg / E314 exit 21. Public Gays-Cruising spot page has dated user messages on 1–7 April 2026 arranging/asking about meetings at the location and shows 244 last-month platform check-ins as captured (time relative to original crawl). These are dated activity reports/intention, NOT independently observed physical attendance. Official Flemish traffic authority confirms carpool lot of 28 car spaces.

p3_2026_11_08.original_report: FULL original detail read. Classified rest area, claims parking increasingly visited; source self-rates high volume, medium privacy, day-long (undated editorial). Public Feb-Aug 2025 cached comments are mostly invitations, not proof. Public indexed April 2026 cached snapshot reveals 10 same-site dated messages 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-07, including visit-time proposals and arrival questions, NOT witnessed sex. Cached source shows 3.8k all-time check-ins, 244 last month, 0 now: relative window is as of capture April 2026, not Nov 2026 and not independently proven attendance. Distinct from nearby 'Zijwegje' 0.4 km away.

coordinates.provenance: Gays-Cruising Get Directions original destination; reported carpool spot point, not on-site survey

alternatives.finding: 2026-11-01 E314 exit list distinguishes Rotselaar Noord nearby at Exit 21 Holsbeek, confirming motorway approach, not confirming activity.
Official PDF inventory from previous source archive not examined in this pass; do not claim official proof from it.

p3_2026_11_08.location: Carpool parking at Holsbeek, near E314 exit 21 and Holsbeeksesteenweg; original source pin explicitly 50.9335518,4.7433043.
p3_2026_11_08.cruising: Recent dated meeting discussions in April 2026 (questions and plans), not independently confirmed physical encounters. Geographic spot identity well established, 2026 access still requires checking with operator.
